notes.title: 【Naughty Demon】has been released
notes.notes:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625110/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]《Naughty Demon》 is now officially released on Steam![/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]This is an RPG focused on an adventure story,[/b][/p][p][b]with a touch of lewd elements sprinkled throughout.[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Chapter 1:[b] Encounter with the demon girl Tia[/b][/p][p]Chapter 2:[b] Memories with the catgirl Coco[/b][/p][p]Chapter 3:[b] Collecting lewd items + bonus events[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]The game offers three difficulty modes: [i]Easy, Normal, and Challenge.[/i]
If things feel too tough, you can also switch to [i]Story Mode[/i], which grants you a one-hit-kill weapon.[/b][/p][p][b]There are [/b]two different endings[b] to the story.
After finishing the game, you can collect the lewd items either through normal gameplay or simply unlock them all with one click.[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]If you run into any issues or have suggestions, feel free to share them on Steam or Discord.

[/b][/p][p][b]We hope you enjoy the game:)[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Twitter（X）：[/b][/p][p][url="https://x.com/StudioAqua84682"]https://x.com/StudioAqua84682[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Discord：[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/FmqdckWu4q"]https://discord.gg/FmqdckWu4q[/url][/p][p][/p]
